title: [Feature Request] Expose how much context is left before auto-compact
body:
## Description

At some point, Claude Code starts to warn you about the context getting too long and how much percentage is left before auto-compact. It would be nice to be able to have a command that exposes that percentage on command. (Maybe add it to the `/cost` response or something(?))
author: hesreallyhim

top_comments.author: neonconsultingllc
top_comments.body: It would be great if Claude had awareness of this as well. Would give it a chance to update memory before it gets brainwashed.
